page.layout: One page of a table: a running head and page number at the top; the column headings beneath; six-row blocks of Indict. numbers with year columns; the Dec. notes stand beside the Feriæ column; the Christi column at the far right; a gathering signature at the bottom right.

main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | lit. dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ. | | Christi.

page.notes: The Dec. notes (24, 23, 22, 21, 20, 19, 18, 17 Dec.) stand between the Feriæ and Christi columns and are placed in their rows. The Christi numbers are set in a decorative 9-like form, copied here as 9xx. The mark after 1716 in the first row appears as a small stroke; I read it as a stray mark and copied 4 as the Feriæ value. The signature at the bottom right is hard to read and is given as Io[?].
